definitions.gloss: image quality; picture quality; resolution quality
definitions.explanation: The quality or clarity of an image, photograph, or video. Composed of 画 (image, picture) + 質 (quality). Commonly used when discussing cameras, displays, video streaming, and digital media.

examples.japanese: このカメラは{画質|がしつ}がいい。
examples.english: This camera has good image quality.

examples.japanese: {画質|がしつ}を{上|あ}げると、データ{容量|ようりょう}も{大|おお}きくなる。
examples.english: When you increase the image quality, the file size also gets larger.

examples.japanese: {動画|どうが}の{画質|がしつ}が{悪|わる}くて、{字幕|じまく}が{読|よ}めなかった。
examples.english: The video quality was so poor that I couldn't read the subtitles.

notes:
USAGE:
{画質|がしつ} is an everyday term in the digital age, frequently seen in product reviews, streaming service settings, and camera specifications. It covers both still images and video.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高|こう}{画質|がしつ} (high image quality — HD, 4K, etc.)
- {低|てい}{画質|がしつ} (low image quality)
- {画質|がしつ}がいい/わるい (good/bad image quality)
- {画質|がしつ}{設定|せってい} (image quality settings)
- {画質|がしつ}を{調整|ちょうせい}する (to adjust image quality)
